|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “If you have a piloted AT-AT on Hoth, target one of opponent's artillery weapons at a related site, and target is lost. OR Once per turn, ▲ Crash Landing or Weapon Malfunction. [Immune to Sense]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Debris Zone (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Once per turn, take Crash Landing or Weapon Malfunction into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If you have a piloted AT-AT on Hoth, target artillery weapon at a related site is lost. (Immune to Sense.)” '''What changed:''' added “Once per turn, take Crash Landing or Weapon Malfunction into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR”; removed “one of opponent's”; “weapons” → “weapon”; “site, and target” → “site”; “OR Once per turn, ▲ Crash Landing or Weapon Malfunction. [Immune” → “(Immune”; “Sense]” → “Sense.)”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards4.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown); page 4, slip 35.
